n7ab3e2acc5.summary: OneSpaWorld reported total revenues of $200.5 million, income from operations of $13.4 million and adjusted EBITDA of $21.6 million. It introduced Q3 2023 revenue guidance of $205-210 million.
n7ab3e2acc5.why: OneSpaWorld operates spa and wellness services on cruise ships and at resorts, so its results reflect demand in the cruise and hospitality sectors.

n321a08e951.summary: The 2023 US State Department Investment Climate report cites corruption, insecurity and institutional division as significant barriers to foreign investment in Libya.

n8cbc451ad8.headline: Amerigo Announces Q2-2023 Results & Quarterly Dividend
n8cbc451ad8.summary: Amerigo Resources reported a Q2 2023 net loss of $3.8 million, driven by lower copper production and prior-quarter price settlement adjustments. It declared a quarterly dividend of Cdn$0.03 per share.
n8cbc451ad8.why: Amerigo is a Vancouver-based copper producer, so its results reflect copper output and prices. Copper is a key industrial metal used in construction and electrification.

n4255da9d33.headline: Hungary's Inflation Control: Are Price Caps on Groceries Going to Create Shortages?
n4255da9d33.summary: Hungary introduced official price controls on essential food items in February 2022 to curb inflation, extending them several times. The freeze was reported to be phased out by end-July 2023.
n4255da9d33.why: Price controls can distort supply and margins for food retailers, affecting inflation and consumer price dynamics.

nbe48534713.headline: Thai reformist party will not be part of coalition to form the next government, former ally says
nbe48534713.summary: The Thai party that won the most seats in May's general election will not join the coalition forming the next government, its former ally said, amid conservative opposition.
nbe48534713.why: Government formation in Thailand determines economic policy, and political uncertainty can weigh on the baht and Thai equities.

n1a212e0818.headline: Germany builds up LNG import terminals
n1a212e0818.summary: The EU Commission approved a 40 million euro support measure for the land-based LNG terminal at Brunsbuettel on Germany's North Sea coast. The Commission cited the terminal's contribution to supply security.
n1a212e0818.why: LNG import terminals give Germany access to gas beyond pipeline supply, affecting European gas prices and energy security. Public support for such facilities is closely watched by energy investors.

nb7e0e9da42.headline: Israeli economy boosted by gas revenues from new offshore
nb7e0e9da42.summary: Israel's economy is benefiting from gas revenues from new offshore fields. Israel plans to double gas production and link to new markets, including Europe, with total reserves estimated at 1,087 bcm in 2022.
nb7e0e9da42.why: Israel's offshore gas fields in the eastern Mediterranean are a growing source of export revenue and energy supply for Europe.

n5b4ac68113.summary: An economic expert says Nigerians expect functional refineries to cushion the effects of subsidy removal on petrol (PMS). The comments were reported by Pulse Nigeria.
n5b4ac68113.why: Nigeria is a major oil producer that imports much of its refined fuel, so domestic refining capacity and fuel subsidy policy directly affect pump prices and inflation.
